scope: Reviewed all current guides against the native B&W implementation and the active geared, firing, fuel-service and Relay integrations.
Retained the maintainer's confirmed in-game testing of 0.3.0 and the exact Railroader 2025.1/UMM compatibility note; removed an unsupported multiplayer-testing statement.
Corrected dependency scope, carrier coverage, consumption inputs, aux-tender contract wording and the distinction between visual simulation and synchronized controls.

Documented 0.3.0 development interfaces for geared profiles/audio, oil and wood firing, finite/infinite fuel facilities, authoring helpers, runtime results, observers, units, defaults, authority and persistence.
Kept historical release content separate from current APIs; checked existing downloadable examples and version navigation.

Audited the historical 0.2.0/0.2.1 loader manifests and endpoint implementation; recorded explicit errata for the Library of Stuff requirement, endpoint rotation and Windows editor path. Removed unsupported historical revalidation wording.

Reviewed the valve gear authoring proposal planned for B&W 0.4.0: three-cycle preparation, section mapping, preview, proposed Script configuration, optional activation, export and reviewer feedback. Marked every future plan as subject to change and separated proposal status from existing release validation.
Kept future-plan pages and navigation outside new release snapshots; added coverage to the snapshot/erratum regression test while preserving published archive metadata and digests.

Reviewed the proposed 0.4.0 steam-plant authoring workflow, profile/circuit sketches, AE calibration references, optional activation and cab bindings. Marked the target, APIs and examples as subject to change and distinguished missing physical inputs from supported defaults.
Matched all 0.3.0 exports, authoring templates and settings to the combined implementation; documented target/value validation, provider-conflict handling and persistent fuel controls.

Reviewed current-build offline and native evidence: geared regressions, core behavior, actual native definition parsing, executed Relay consumers and data-only authoring, curve concurrency, immediate reload, and two-pack author audio cleanup/reload.

Clarified the valve gear proposal in response to author feedback: separate model parts can share a complete baked clip, all three cycles reuse the same driver rotation with different reverser settings, and the ordinary driver clip remains a fallback. Reviewed the bake steps and articulated-section wording against that intended workflow.
runtimeStatus: B&W 0.3.0 has been tested in-game, as confirmed by the maintainer on 2026-11-01. This audit does not assign invented per-feature test coverage. The valve gear proposal planned for 0.4.0 makes no claim of implemented runtime behavior, ADK acceptance or in-game validation. The steam-plant proposal planned for 0.4.0 is an author-review document, not a working example pack or a gameplay-validation claim. The final combined artifact passed these isolated checks on Railroader 0.6.2 build 26335745 / Unity 6000.3.26f1. Fresh combined gameplay, editor, save/reload and multiplayer acceptance remain separate; the earlier maintainer-confirmed in-game testing is retained without expanding its coverage.
followUp: Reconcile the valve gear proposal with implemented behavior and author feedback before promoting it to release authoring documentation; the 0.4.0 target and interfaces remain subject to change.
Reconcile the steam-plant proposal with modder feedback and the eventual implementation before publishing supported authoring examples or Railroader compatibility claims.
Complete separately authorized combined gameplay, editor, save/reload and multiplayer acceptance; re-audit compatibility after game updates.
reviewType: Behavioral source audit, maintainer corrections and active integration review; future-plan authoring and snapshot boundary review
